description: This PHP source file defines the EmailSubscriptionAPI class, which extends a base Endpoint class and implements CRUD operations related to email subscriptions in an admin context. It includes API documentation annotations for OpenAPI, methods for listing and updating email subscriptions, and utilizes various service and model classes for data handling.
